title: Hyrax: An Extensible Framework for Rapid ML Experimentation and Unsupervised Discovery in the Era of Rubin, Roman, and Euclid
abstract: arXiv:2605.18959v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory, Roman Space Telescope, Euclid, and other next-generation surveys will deliver imaging, spectroscopic, and time-domain data at scales that increasingly shift the bottleneck in astronomical machine learning (ML) projects from model design to infrastructure. We present Hyrax, an open-source, modular, GPU-enabled Python framework that supports the full ML lifecycle in astronomy: from data acquisition and training to inference and experiment comparison, with capabilities including multimodal dataset support, integrated vector databases for similarity search, and interactive two- and three-dimensional latent-space exploration for unsupervised discovery. tldr: Hyrax是一个开源、模块化、GPU加速的Python框架，为Rubin、Roman和Euclid时代的天文机器学习提供覆盖数据获取、训练、推理到实验比较的全生命周期支持，并集成向量数据库相似性搜索与交互式潜空间探索以实现无监督科学发现。
